The '''Gromas system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] within the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] containing [[Gromas/Legends|Gromas]] and its [[phrikite]]-laden [[Moon/Legends|moons]].

Gromas system was largerly ignored among the industrial and mining worlds of the sector, notable only for its panorama of moons of various colors. This changed when, shortly before [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], phrikite desposits were discovered on those moons. Prospectors filed competing claims on [[Trancret]], the sector capital, and hastily assembled exploration companies seeking backing on the [[Trancret Stock Exchange]]. This period of activity on Trancret, and exploration of the system stopped, when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], seeking for material to fund the [[Dark Trooper Project]], voided all claims and annexed the system. The project turned out to be top secret and the system was closed-off, disappointing the [[Trancretes]] who hoped for jobs or cooperation with the Empire.<ref name="Tales">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/kylekatarnstale3|series=Kyle Katarn's Tale|text=Mission 3}}</ref>

The Empire had constructed a major [[mining/Legends|mining]] and refining facility on [[Gromas 16]] and several satellite minor facilities on other moons, until the Dark Trooper Project was finished and pulled off. Imperial warships stopped traveling along the routes, allowing a few brave explorers to return to Gromas, where they found the Gromas 16 base destroyed from a reactor failure (actually the result of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Mission to Gromas|sabotage]]) and the facilities abandoned, along with equipment including mining droids.<ref name="Tales" /> 

Another period of new claims and explorations began with Emperor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]'s [[Battle of Endor/Legends|death]]. The [[GromasMines Cooperative]] was established to resolve the claims. Its operations brought a new wave of prosperity for the sector.<ref name="Tales" />
